messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>

Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Kate Miller <kate.miller@bluehaven.health>, Rajesh Patel <rajesh@bluehaven.health>
Date: Tue, 26 May 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Bluehaven Health — staging readiness, rollforward plan and CS owner

Hi team,

We closed Bluehaven yesterday — signing is complete and payments are in motion. High level: 150k ARR, 6-month initial contract, expected 5x daily API calls by week 6 (avg 100k tokens/day initially). They requested a tight staging-to-prod window and want the option for a one-click rollback if the model responses diverge from baseline.

What sales has delivered (attached): SOW_Bluehaven_v2.pdf (scope + acceptance), a first-draft deployment_checklist.xlsx, and a prod_access_matrix.csv with proposed accounts/roles. HubSpot is RBW-2026-0147 (link below).

Asks for CS before handoff:
- Confirm primary CS owner and a backup (we recommend Monica primary, Marcus backup).
- Can CS run an initial technical kickoff with the customer's engineering team next Tue (June 1) 10–11am PT? They specifically want a short demo of the sandbox and a plan for API key rotation.
- Security: Bluehaven requires a SOC2-limited evidence packet and confirmation that logs are retained 90 days. They also asked about KMS integration (they prefer AWS KMS).
- Acceptance criteria callouts in the SOW: model drift tolerance +/- 8% on NPS-style quality tests — please review and flag if that's operationally unrealistic.

I can do a 20-minute sync with CS before the kickoff tomorrow (May 27) at 9am PT if helpful.

Attachments: SOW_Bluehaven_v2.pdf, deployment_checklist.xlsx, prod_access_matrix.csv

Links: HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/company/9876543
DocuSign (signed): https://www.docusign.net/Member/PowerFormSigning.aspx?PowerFormId=abc123
Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c4d-bluehaven-handbook

Thanks — Soojin

--

From: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>

Date: Tue, 26 May 2026 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Bluehaven Health — staging readiness, rollforward plan and CS owner

Thanks Soojin — congrats on the close. Quick clarifying Qs before I take this forward:

1) Is Bluehaven expecting a managed on-prem connector or are they fully cloud-hosted? (SOW references both integration patterns).
2) The prod_access_matrix lists 12 internal Bluehaven users — do they expect RBW-managed identities or SSO (SAML)? I need to know for provisioning and invitation flow.
3) For the rollback request: do they want automatic traffic switchback or a manual playbook? If automatic, we need the exact thresholds and a runbook for tests to compare pre/post behavior.
4) SOC2 evidence: do we have a pre-packaged PDF we can hand them, or should I coordinate with Security for a tailored packet?

Assuming Monica is primary owner — tentative plan: technical kickoff June 1 10–11am PT (I'll block). I'll ask engineering to prepare the sandbox demo and an API-key rotation checklist.

Can someone confirm who will own the initial 30/60/90 success metrics (sales suggested adoption targets but we should formalize). Also flagging possible risk: if they push to prod inside 2 weeks, our staging capacity (in us-west) needs a pre-warm; Ops may need notice for reserved nodes.

I'll prepare a short CS handover doc for the kickoff and include a risk register.

—Monica

--
Monica Patel | Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
monica@redwood.com
From: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Kate Miller <kate.miller@bluehaven.health>
Date: Tue, 26 May 2026 17:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Bluehaven Health — staging readiness, rollforward plan and CS owner

Monica — answers inline:
1) Bluehaven is cloud-hosted in AWS. They will not use an on-prem connector for phase 1.
2) They prefer SAML SSO for provisioning. I attached the prod_access_matrix.csv with the suggested roles; procurement asked we support SSO + short-lived RBW tokens for service accounts.
3) Rollback: customer asked for a manual two-step rollback (switch traffic back + invalidate new model) with a <30-minute target. They did NOT request an automated, threshold-based rollback. We should still keep the rollback playbook light.
4) SOC2: Sales has a standard SOC2 evidence packet — see Drive link. Security team already pre-cleared the packet for general distribution, but any tailored requests should go to security@redwood.com.

30/60/90 success metrics: Sales proposed weekly active users (WAU) -> 200 by week 6, request completion rate > 85%, latency P95 < 450ms. These are negotiable at kickoff.

I'll be on the kickoff to introduce and close the loop. Confirming I want Monica as primary and Marcus as backup.

Thanks,
Soojin

--
